bootstrap.sampling_unit: one saved trajectory containing BOTH cosine and sine
bootstrap.stream_rule: distinct deterministic streams for every endpoint/n
bootstrap.comparison: strict PR < fixed PF; ties separately counted

cumulative: all prefixes in ascending saved replica order; no permutation

SE_definitions.within_resample: sample SD / sqrt(n) within each resampled trajectory set

event_analysis: saved trajectory strata only; no raw event or law reconstruction
resource_policy: vectorized per-n arrays; existing affinity/quota; no agent CPU/RAM/worker cap
